name: Inspectlet
line: Records website sessions and provides heatmaps and form analysis.

free.text: Free: 3 sites, 1-month history; replay limit unclear

cells.cookieless: No, uses session and visitor cookies

pv.math: Billed by recorded sessions. The free replay limit is unclear: it is listed as both 2,500 and 5,000 a month. Micro starts at $39 a month for 10,000 replays.
